payload.title: File:Laueropterus vitriolus (holotype, mandible).png
payload.credit_html: "A new early monofenestratan pterosaur from the Mörnsheim Formation of southern Germany"
payload.description_html: Mandible of the Laueropterus vitriolus holotype (LF 6268). Mandible as seen in ventral view. (A) General view of the robust element. Scale bar is 50 mm. (B) Close-up of the jaw tip, showing the orientation of the teeth and the bulges of the roots showing through the bone. Scale bar = 10 mm.
